responsibility: This header declares the native C/C++ interface for gm2’s Modula-2-style tree pretty printer. It defines the m2pp_dump_kind output categories used for stdout, pre-genericize, post-genericize, and file-descriptor dumps; declares the dump creation, gated pretty-print, close, and fd-output entry points implemented in m2pp.cc; and publishes a small set of GDB-oriented helper routines in namespace modula2 for interactively printing trees during frontend debugging.
same_name_distinction: Native C/C++ declaration surface for m2pp: unlike m2pp.cc, which implements the pretty-printer and dump operations, and unlike m2pp.def, which provides only the Modula-2 FFI declarations, this header defines the shared dump-kind enum and declares the full C/C++ entry points, including the gated pretty-print function and GDB-oriented helpers.
